rationale: Record a browser-capture robustness fix that crosses the design-source-ingest and design-output-and-packaging families through their tools/import-design/** selectors, the chromium-authoring-frontend family through tools/import-design/**/*browser*, and design-source-ingest again through .agents/skills/import-design/**. In tools/import-design/browser_capture, captureStableFrameWithHiddenPaint reuses the already-accepted stable frame when the page reports zero hidden elements instead of running a second identical screenshot horizon, and guardian custody during browser launch now shares the launch deadline (5 s floor) instead of a fixed 5 s wait; settle and browser_process node tests cover both, and the import-design skill documents the behaviour. Capture output bytes, DesignIR, rendering, codegen, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
